title: Monic triangular relations and independent bounded products over an algebraic base field
statement: Let F and K be fields with an F-algebra structure [def-pc-field-extension], and let b:Fin m→K be a finite family of elements integral over F [def-weil-algebraic-element]. There are monic polynomials q_i in F[Z_j:j<i][Y_i] [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring, def-weil-polynomial-ring], indexed by i:Fin m, such that evaluating Z_j at b_j and Y_i at b_i gives zero. The products ∏_i b_i^{a_i}, indexed by a:(i:Fin m)→Fin(natDegree(q_i)), are linearly independent over F [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. This statement does not assert a spanning property or any localization.

proof.text: At a successor let L be the intermediate field generated over F by the preceding elements. Their integrality implies that L equals their generated subalgebra (IntermediateField.adjoin_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic), so evaluation of multivariate polynomials onto L is surjective. The last element is integral over L. Lift its minimal polynomial coefficientwise along this surjection, preserving monicity and natural degree, using Polynomial.lifts_and_natDegree_eq_and_monic. Polynomial.eval₂_map and minpoly.aeval prove vanishing of the lifted last relation. Keep the preceding triangular relations.

proof.text: Regard the preceding bounded products as elements of L. Their independence follows from that of their images in K by LinearIndependent.of_comp. Mathlib linearIndependent_smul combines this family with the L-independent new powers. Map a full exponent tuple to its initial tuple and last exponent; this map is injective by Fin.lastCases. LinearIndependent.comp and Fin.prod_univ_castSucc identify its product family with the required bounded products. No spanning assertion or quotient presentation is needed.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_algebraicTower_triangularRelations
    (F : Type u) (K : Type v) [Field F] [Field K] [Algebra F K]
    (m : ℕ) (b : Fin m → K) (hb : ∀ i, IsIntegral F (b i)) :
    ∃ q : (i : Fin m) → Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin i.val) F),
      (∀ i, (q i).Monic) ∧
      (∀ i, Polynomial.eval₂
        (MvPolynomial.aeval (fun j : Fin i.val ↦ b ⟨j.val, by omega⟩)).toRingHom
        (b i) (q i) = 0) ∧
      LinearIndependent F
        (fun a : ((i : Fin m) → Fin ((q i).natDegree)) ↦ ∏ i, b i ^ (a i).val)
